title: MCP server is hand-rolled JSON-RPC, not the official MCP SDK
evidence: src/SoccerMcp/McpServer.cs:7 implements initialize/tools/list/tools/call/ping over newline-delimited stdio by hand
suggestion: Acceptable per REQUIREMENTS.json R1 (tool definitions + entrypoint exist); an official SDK would reduce protocol-maintenance surface

title: 15 tools implemented, well beyond the spec's query categories
evidence: src/SoccerMcp/Tools.cs:30 All exposes derbies, compare_seasons, best_records, biggest_wins, team_competitions, dataset_info in addition to the required queries
suggestion: No action; noted as scope beyond the pinned requirements

title: Cross-dataset dedup and single-source-per-season standings avoid double counting
evidence: src/SoccerMcp/SoccerService.cs:37 Dedupe and src/SoccerMcp/SoccerService.cs:145 SeasonMatches pick the largest source file per competition-season

title: Very terse helpers reduce readability
evidence: src/SoccerMcp/Tools.cs:22-26 single-letter helpers S/I/D and l0/Limit; stored maintainability=0.70 in scores.json
suggestion: Rename to intent-revealing names (e.g. GetString/GetInt/ParseLimit) to improve maintainability

title: Relegation tag assumes a 20-team, full-season table
evidence: src/SoccerMcp/Tools.cs:128,131 tags bottom-4 as relegated only when table.Count>=20; partial-season or Serie B/C tables get no relegation info
suggestion: Gate on completeness or expected team count per competition; minor since R9 (standings computed from results) is fully satisfied
